data.gender_notes: Sarangdhar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sarangdhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'saranga', which means 'love' or 'affection'. The name is associated with Lord Krishna, who is known to have immense love and compassion towards his devotees. Sarangdhar symbolizes the love and care that a father should have for his child. The name Sarangdhar carries the meaning “Lord of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sarangdhar usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
